ui.settings.notifications.section.title.role: Settings section heading and sidebar entry
ui.settings.notifications.section.title.length: Heading; one line. English is 13 characters.
ui.settings.notifications.section.title.note: Names the whole destination: banners and their sound.

ui.settings.notifications.section.descri.length: One line on desktop; may wrap. English is 62 characters.
ui.settings.notifications.section.descri.note: "Local Operator" is the product name: never translate it.

ui.settings.notifications.sound.heading.note: Groups the sound switch, volume and the list of sounds.

ui.settings.notifications.sound.enabled_.length: Row label beside a switch; one line. English is 12 characters.
ui.settings.notifications.sound.enabled_.note: Turns notification sounds on or off.

ui.settings.notifications.sound.enabled_.length: Wraps under the label. English is 52 characters.
ui.settings.notifications.sound.enabled_.note: A banner is the desktop notification pop-up.

ui.settings.notifications.sound.enabled_.role: Status line shown when the switch is off
ui.settings.notifications.sound.enabled_.length: One line under the switch. English is 46 characters.
ui.settings.notifications.sound.enabled_.note: The selected sound is remembered while sound is off; the list stays usable.

ui.settings.notifications.sound.gated.role: Info notice when notifications are turned off
ui.settings.notifications.sound.gated.length: Inline alert, wraps. English is 81 characters.
ui.settings.notifications.sound.gated.note: Appears above the sound controls, which stay usable.

ui.settings.notifications.sound.gated_ac.length: Button label, one line. English is 21 characters.
ui.settings.notifications.sound.gated_ac.note: Turns on the main notifications switch shown just above.

ui.settings.notifications.volume.label.length: Row label; one line. English is 6 characters.

ui.settings.notifications.volume.readout.role: Read-only value beside the volume slider
ui.settings.notifications.volume.readout.tone: Machine voice; number with percent sign.
ui.settings.notifications.volume.readout.note: {value} is 0-100. Use the locale's normal percent formatting and spacing.

ui.settings.notifications.volume.readout.role: Read-only value when the volume is at its default
ui.settings.notifications.volume.readout.length: Very short; never wraps. English is 13 characters.
ui.settings.notifications.volume.readout.note: {value} is the number. "Default" means the factory setting. Keep the middle dot separator or the locale's equivalent.

ui.settings.notifications.volume.reset.note: Puts the volume back to its default (70).

ui.settings.notifications.volume.descrip.note: When the user releases the slider, the selected sound plays at the new level.

ui.settings.notifications.volume.muted.length: One line, may wrap. English is 48 characters.

ui.settings.notifications.volume.system.role: Helper text when the System sound is selected
ui.settings.notifications.volume.system.note: The slider is disabled because the operating system plays its own alert.

ui.settings.notifications.volume.valuete.note: {value} is 0-100. Read aloud by assistive technology.

ui.settings.notifications.list.label.role: Accessible name of the list of sounds
ui.settings.notifications.list.label.note: Names the radio group of sounds.

ui.settings.notifications.list.builtin.note: Sounds that ship with the app.

ui.settings.notifications.list.default_t.role: Small tag beside the default sound
ui.settings.notifications.list.default_t.note: Marks the sound that is selected out of the box.

ui.settings.notifications.list.system_na.role: Name of the system sound option
ui.settings.notifications.list.system_na.note: Choosing it means the app plays nothing and the OS or terminal alert plays.

ui.settings.notifications.list.system_de.length: One line, may wrap. English is 57 characters.
ui.settings.notifications.list.system_de.note: Explains that the app adds no sound of its own.

ui.settings.notifications.list.custom.role: Subheading over the user's own sounds
ui.settings.notifications.list.custom.note: Sounds the user added from their own files.

ui.settings.notifications.list.custom_co.note: {count} is how many custom sounds exist; {max} is the limit (50).

ui.settings.notifications.preview.play.role: Accessible name of the play button
ui.settings.notifications.preview.play.note: {name} is the sound's name; custom names are the user's own text.

ui.settings.notifications.preview.stop.role: Accessible name of the stop button

ui.settings.notifications.preview.failed.note: The preview audio failed to load or play.

ui.settings.notifications.save.failed.role: Error under the list when a selection failed to save
ui.settings.notifications.save.failed.length: Wraps. English is 25 characters plus the reason.
ui.settings.notifications.save.failed.note: {reason} is a sentence from the server; it may be empty.

ui.settings.notifications.save.failed_ge.role: Fallback error when the server gave no reason
ui.settings.notifications.save.failed_ge.note: Shown when there is no server-supplied reason.

ui.settings.notifications.retry.role: Button that repeats a failed action
ui.settings.notifications.retry.note: Used for a failed save, load or upload.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.empty.note: "the assistant" is the AI agent in the app, which can generate sound effects.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.add.role: Button that opens a file picker
ui.settings.notifications.custom.add.tone: Short imperative with ellipsis (opens a dialog).
ui.settings.notifications.custom.add.note: Keep the ellipsis: it signals a picker opens.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.hint.note: Format names stay in Latin script. {seconds} is 10, {megabytes} is 10. Loudness matching means the app evens out volume.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.full.role: Line shown when the limit is reached

ui.settings.notifications.custom.uploadi.role: Progress label on a pending row

ui.settings.notifications.custom.process.role: Label while the server processes the file
ui.settings.notifications.custom.process.note: The server is adjusting the file's loudness.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.cancel_.role: Accessible name of the cancel button on a pending row
ui.settings.notifications.custom.cancel_.note: {file} is the file name the user chose.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.more.role: Accessible name of the row's menu button

ui.settings.notifications.custom.rename.note: Opens a text field to change the sound's name.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.rename_.role: Accessible name of the rename field
ui.settings.notifications.custom.rename_.note: The user's own name for a sound.
Shown when the field is empty on Enter.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.rename_.role: Inline error under the rename field
ui.settings.notifications.custom.rename_.note: {reason} is a sentence from the server; may be empty.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.remove.tone: Plain imperative with ellipsis (asks to confirm).
ui.settings.notifications.custom.remove.note: Keep the ellipsis: a confirmation follows.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.remove_.role: Inline confirmation when removing the selected sound
ui.settings.notifications.custom.remove_.note: {name} is the sound's name. "Soft pulse" is the name of the default built-in sound; use the same translation the built-in list shows.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.removed.note: "Soft pulse" is the default built-in sound's name.

ui.settings.notifications.custom.remove_.note: {reason} is a sentence from the server; may be empty.

ui.settings.notifications.error.unsuppor.note: Format names stay in Latin script.
Format names stay in Latin script.

ui.settings.notifications.error.too_long.role: Upload error for a long clip
ui.settings.notifications.error.too_long.note: {seconds} is the measured length (e.g. 12.4); {limit} is 10. The clip is refused, not trimmed.

ui.settings.notifications.error.network.role: Upload error when the server did not answer

ui.settings.notifications.error.choose_a.role: Link button on an error row

ui.settings.notifications.error.dismiss.role: Accessible name of the close button on an error row

ui.settings.notifications.test.action.note: Shows one real desktop notification with the chosen sound.

ui.settings.notifications.test.sent.role: Status after the test was sent
ui.settings.notifications.test.sent.note: "Focus" and "Do Not Disturb" are OS feature names; use the OS's localized names.

ui.settings.notifications.test.failed.role: Status when the test could not be shown
ui.settings.notifications.test.failed.note: Notifications may be unsupported or suppressed.

ui.settings.notifications.test.banner_ti.role: Title of the test desktop notification

ui.settings.notifications.test.banner_bo.role: Body of the test desktop notification

ui.settings.notifications.load.failed.role: Warning when the list failed to load

ui.settings.notifications.backend_older.role: Line shown when the backend is too old

ui.settings.notifications.missing_rows.role: Diagnostic line when settings are missing
ui.settings.notifications.missing_rows.note: {rows} is a list of setting keys; never translate them.
